verdicts.reason: A is just the portrait poster shrunk and centred on a wide canvas. The rings and the title are small, the subtitle lines are tiny and hard to read, and large dead zones sit on both sides, so it doesn't suit a banner. B puts the larger orbit graphic on the left and the text on the right, which reads left to right and keeps the copy a little larger. But the text block sinks into the bottom-right corner with empty space above it instead of sitting level with the graphic, and the outer rings run close to the left and bottom edges.
